description: Windows-only: the updater and process plugins are never registered on mobile (see lib.rs's #[cfg(windows)] gate), so their permissions are scoped the same way here. Confirmed live against a real running build -- `plugin:updater|check` ALSO failed with "not allowed by ACL" with no capabilities file present, meaning the silent desktop auto-updater had never actually completed a real check through its own code path before this.
